route.label: Daydream: replay the verified r18 to r22 prefix, then one r22 to r25 observation

steps.label: Verified prefix: one Enter at the ready cinema r18
Log ready cinema r22, then send the only new Enter
Log ready cinema r25 and stop without input

manual_acceptance: Before the new press, confirm the r22 probe shows ordered sources [20,21], exact and composited, with a naturally completed and committed current epoch and no movie.

Check that the fresh, nonrepeated physical Keyboard(13) is consumed by bottom-button owner 8 (region 62, logical key 2, group 0, response 0) and that message-resume [2, 0, 0, 0] occurs in the same frame. Cinema is the ready body window, not the consuming receiver. A down event or route completion alone is not proof of consumption.
At r25, require source [24] in the same CST context and load, with a fresh naturally completed and committed current epoch, exact and composited. No subsequent press is defined.
review.limitation: This legacy observation config does not declare keyboard_press. Use pc_story_17_r18_to_r25_guarded_enter.json with the strict validator to enforce the consuming receipt.
